title: Book Three · Chapter 14: A Name for the Boy
story:
On Saturday morning, Ronan takes the second letter from his shelf.

Mum is waiting for her customer. She has a coat across her knees.

“Have you got the address?” she asks.

“On the envelope.”

“And your money?”

He taps his pocket.

The customer comes through the green door as Ronan leaves. He steps aside for her, then walks toward the post office.

This time, he does not need to ask about the stamp. He pays at the counter, fixes it to the envelope, and takes the letter outside.

He checks the front once. Then he drops it into the post box.

His second letter is on its way to Leo.

Someone calls his name from the next shop.

Ronan turns. The boy with the ball stands in the doorway. He is holding a small wooden car.

“You live near here?” the boy asks.

“West Lane. Near the green door.”

“I know the pencil stall there.”

“Mr Qiu's.”

The boy comes out. One wheel is missing from the car. A little paper bag is in his other hand.

Ronan looks at the doorway behind him. The shop sells tools and small metal parts.

“Is that your car?”

“My cousin's now. It was mine.”

“Did you break it?”

“Not this time.”

The boy opens the paper bag. A wheel and a short screw lie inside.

“I found the wheel. I needed this.”

He lifts the screw between two fingers. Then he puts it away carefully.

Another boy comes down the street. He calls, “Kai! Are you ready?”

The boy with the car raises a hand.

Ronan looks at him. Now he has a name for the boy from the first morning. Kai. He knows the face and the ball, but he did not know the name before today.

“Kai?” he asks.

“Yes.”

“I know your ball better than your name.”

Kai looks down at the wooden car.

“The ball doesn't have a name.”

“We can give it yours.”

“Then everyone will throw me at the wall.”

Ronan laughs. Kai's friend reaches them and looks at the car.

“Can you do it now?”

“At home. I need a screwdriver.”

They have plans to visit Kai's cousin after the repair. Ronan needs to go home. He tells Kai he will see him at school.

On West Lane, Mr Qiu is counting pencils into bundles.

“Letter gone?” he asks.

“Yes.”

“Then you need a new sheet of paper.”

“Not yet. Leo needs time to read this one.”

Ronan goes through the green door. Mum's customer is still there. He takes his books into the yard and leaves them room beside the window.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

wheel＝轮子；screw＝螺丝；screwdriver＝螺丝刀；cousin＝堂／表兄弟姐妹。

## 理解问题

1. 本章的第二封信有没有寄出？Ronan这次有没有等Mum陪同？
2. Ronan怎样第一次知道Kai的名字？Kai买小螺丝是为了修什么？

## 读句子

**A wheel and a short screw lie inside.**

拆开看：A wheel and a short screw / lie / inside.

一个轮子和一颗短螺丝／放着／放在里面。
